description: Dividend history and the next payout for one Moscow Exchange security. Returns declared and forecast payouts with their announcement status, the record date, the amount per share and the yield. The yield is a fraction (0.08 = 8 %), not a percentage. A forecast status means the board of directors has not recommended the payout yet: never present such a value as declared.

ticker.description: Ticker of the security on the Moscow Exchange, e.g. SBER, LKOH, GAZP.

name: dividends_by_ticker
title: Dividends for one security
